hook: Naga's entire executive career was built inside two companies that run some of the largest real-time systems on Earth, LinkedIn and Uber, rising internally at Uber over eleven years to become CTO of a platform operating across cities, countries, and hundreds of millions of users.
name: Praveen Neppalli Naga

quote.text: Scaling systems is often easier than scaling organizations. Data is more important than models when it comes to AI. Speed and clarity beat perfection in most real-world decisions.
quote.context: Praveen Neppalli Naga, personal LinkedIn profile summary

timeline.event: Joins LinkedIn as a Software Engineer
timeline.impact: Begins a seven-year run at LinkedIn's engineering organization

timeline.event: Joins Uber as Senior Engineering Manager
Promoted to Senior Director of Engineering
timeline.impact: Expands scope over Uber's engineering organization
Takes technical leadership of Uber's core businesses

timeline.event: Named Chief Technology Officer of Uber

quick_facts: Chief Technology Officer of Uber, leading global engineering across mobility and delivery
Rose through 11 years at Uber from Senior Engineering Manager to CTO
Previously spent 7 years at LinkedIn, from Senior Software Engineer to Senior Engineering Manager
Holds five patents spanning indexing, analytics, and job-matching systems

achievements.title: Named Chief Technology Officer of Uber (December 2025)
achievements.impact: Took overall technical leadership of Uber's global platform after prior roles running Mobility and Delivery engineering.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, Mobility & Delivery, Uber (2024-2025)
achievements.impact: Directed engineering across Uber's core ride-hailing and delivery businesses before his elevation to company-wide CTO.

achievements.title: Vice President of Engineering, Uber (2022-2024)
achievements.impact: Led large-scale engineering organizations through a multi-year period of platform growth.

achievements.title: Five issued patents in indexing, analytics, and job-matching systems
achievements.impact: Contributed inventions in real-time indexing and analytics infrastructure used across large-scale consumer platforms.
